title: NA60013: Port And Harbour Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Port Planning â national policy, functions; individual level â design
principles, cargo volume forecasts, port productivity, general layout of port
works; terminal level planning â general cargo terminal, container terminal,
marinas, fishing ports; Breakwaters â layout, types, stopping area, maneuvering
area, anchorage area, harbor entrances, parametric wave forecasting, stochastic
sea waves, wave spectra, design wave characteristics, return period;
Navigational channel design â ship characteristics, design approach,
environmental factors, simulation models, navigational aids, computation vessel
squat, wave conditions; Dredging â methods, equipments, dredge types, dredge
pumps, cavitation, flow meters, density meters, production meters, pipelines
transport of dredged materials, critical velocity, head losses, friction
factor, production estimate, dredged sediment disposal, contaminated sediments,
capping, cost estimation, environmental impact assessment, water quality
impacts; Restructuring major ports in India, productivity factors of major
ports; VTMS â components of VTMS system; Problem Session.
